KeyEvidence: Yearly commits: 2016: 420, 2017: 305, 2018: 308, 2019: 411, 2020: 153, 2021: 61, 2022: 1, 2023: 0, 2024: 14, 2025: 10. Rise to 2016-2019, then a sustained fall, 30-month zero stretch, small resumption.
Comments: Month-to-month variance is high (spikes up to 110), which supports 'irregular', but the multi-year trend is clearly downward. I read the long-term trend as declining.

KeyEvidence: Bursts in 2019-03 (65), 2020-06 (66), 2022-01 to 2022-03 (69-114), 2022-12 (120), 2025-06 to 2025-08 (78, 32, 60) separated by long low periods (2-15 commits/month). Burst spacing is 10-30 months with no fixed interval.
Comments: Codebook defines cyclical as predictable repeated patterns at fixed intervals (quarterly/annually). These bursts are not periodic, so irregular fits better.

The yearly shape is rise-to-2021/22-then-decline, and monthly activity is spiky without a fixed interval. Could also be argued as 'declining' from the 2021-2022 peak. Not cyclical under the codebook definition.
Author's 'declining' was read off a plot of all 10 projects combined (peaks of 900 commits/month), not ssht. The real series is bursty with no single trend.
